ios.desc:
Bring the trading floor to wherever you are with Stock Ticker+ for Vision Pro. Experience the infinite scrolling stock ticker board that brings you most up to date prices of your preferred stocks. A tap on any ticker reveals comprehensive performance insights.

Features:

- Historical Insights: Access up to five years of historical stock prices
- Latest News: Stay informed with news articles related to your stocks
- Stock Stats: View essential stats about the stock
- Interactive Charts: Engage with our charts to get exact stock price points
- Customization: Tailor the ticker board's speed and look to your liking.

For any inquiries or feedback, reach out to us at help@studiolanes.com
Privacy Policy: https://studiolanes.com/tickers/privacy
